title: Cafe inventory
hint: Live stock per product, each product's movement ledger, and recording waste or count corrections. Click a row to open that product's stock card.

stock.title: Product stock
stock.emptyDescription: Stock builds up once the first purchase is recorded on the purchases page.

card.empty: No movements recorded for this product yet.

form.title: Record waste or adjust stock
form.wasteHint: Waste is entered as a positive amount (the quantity thrown away) and is valued at the average cost.
form.adjustmentHint: A count adjustment is signed: negative means stock is missing, positive means extra; it is not valued.
form.noProducts: There is no active product yet; add one first.
form.noProductsLink: Add a product on the cafe products page
form.needOneLine: At least one complete line is required.
form.invalidQty: Invalid quantity: waste takes a positive number, an adjustment a non-zero (negative or positive) number, with at most three decimals.
form.duplicateProduct: Each product may appear once; merge duplicate lines.

movements.title: Recent stock movements
movements.truncated: Only the last 100 movements are shown.
movements.emptyDescription: Purchases, sales, waste and adjustments will be listed here.
